info.title: Community Connect API
info.description: Secure REST and realtime backend for events, communities, chat, AI, wallet, notifications, and disputes. Every operation includes request and response schemas, accepted enum values for constrained fields, and examples. Money is represented in integer kobo.

post.description: Immediately reviews an owned draft or declined event with Groq for event information, ticket-price consistency, cover-image safety, and Community Connect guidelines. It also retries automatic review for an owned event left pending because Groq was unavailable. Safe events publish automatically; rejected events include actionable stored reasons and an organizer email. If Groq is unavailable, the event remains pending for manual review and can be retried later.
